sources.excerpt: Supernatural Published on April 15, 2010 Prescription Electronics boost / preamp treble boost pedal Information Prescription Electronics BRAND SPANKING NEW from the fuzzicians at PE comes a pedal that will go far beyond your expectations. Inspired by Peter Green's brilliantly conceived raw tone on "The Supernatural" from the Album "A Hard Road" by John Mayall & The Bluesbreakers, this pedal won't disappoint. In addition, we materialized the recreation of the organic tone Eric Clapton and Mick Taylor produced on their Bluesbreakers albums (not a clone of the Dallas Rangemaster). A sweet bottom end with just the right amount of bite. Germanium at its finest... Old and new tone zealots alike will stagger at this fuzzbox's diversity.
